ThingDef.label: vurra
ThingDef.description: An alien worm of uncertain origin, large enough to threaten a lone traveler but neither fast nor especially ferocious. Vurras are usually found trailing larger, stranger things, as if playing a supporting role in something else's hunt.

ThingDef.label: ossik
ThingDef.description: A large flightless bird adapted to living in very arid terrain. Bony plates across its neck defend it from predators and from the scalding heat of the open sand. Slower to anger than its wetland relatives, the ossik is prized as a mount - fast, sure-footed on loose ground, and steady under a rider even at speed.

ThingDef.label: kudda
ThingDef.description: A cactus-form creature that has evolved to roll and creep across the most arid ground on the Rim. Kuddas need almost no water, drawing what little they use from morning condensation, and depend on long unbroken sunlight to live - sustained shade kills a herd.

ThingDef.label: chikka
ThingDef.description: A colonial effort to make the open sand liveable produced this rat-sized creature, its genome spliced with cactus DNA. The result is a hardened green hide studded with medicinal quills and a strange meat that reads as neither plant nor animal to most palates.

ThingDef.label: oxxa
ThingDef.description: A grotesquely enlarged eye that drags itself along on a few fleshy tentacles. Not very useful for much of anything. Said to result from infusing an animal with strange energies from beyond ordinary space.

ThingDef.label: skorra
ThingDef.description: A mobile cactus given crude sentience and toxic barbs. Early trials aimed for a stationary deterrent; giving it a body and a mind of its own proved a mistake, and the facility that made the first skorras was overrun soon after. Skorras can draw a little nutrition from rotting vegetation, but they live and die by direct sunlight - a long eclipse is usually fatal.

ThingDef.label: pukko
ThingDef.description: A fungal quadruped adapted to life outside the swamp, smaller and less dangerous than its wetland kin for lack of water and rot to grow on. Pukkos release clumps of spores every few weeks to reproduce; the resulting young are wholly independent from birth, with no bond to their parent. Risky to hunt, but the raw fungus beneath the hide is edible.

ThingDef.label: thurra
ThingDef.description: Bred as a bigger, stronger relative of the muffalo, the thurra is an ideal pack beast - pneumatized bones keep it strong and dense without the weight. Its carrying capacity varies with the individual, set at birth, and colonies across the Rim have bred thurras for generations chasing the perfect pack animal.

ThingDef.label: vosska
ThingDef.description: A genetic amalgamation of big-cat, shark and sand skink, bred as a ferocious hunter for desert worlds. The vosska can move through loose sand almost as easily as open ground, letting it close on prey from ambush. Dense soils are too firm for it to work through.

ThingDef.label: khorrak
ThingDef.description: A strange crustacean bred for one purpose: mineral processing. The khorrak feeds on iron compounds, chemically working them into a hardened alloy otherwise found only in asteroids. The transmutation is slow, so a khorrak needs long stretches parked among mined steel to do its work.

ThingDef.label: ommok
ThingDef.description: Despite the name, the ommok is a genetically modified creature combining cephalopod and cone-snail traits, bred as cattle for worlds too dry to support ordinary livestock. It tolerates extreme water deprivation and grazes in slow-moving herds across open sand.

ThingDef.label: grommo
ThingDef.description: A lumbering mass of what looks like decomposing plant matter, in fact a sentient mycoid creature. Its bulk is nearly impervious to gunfire, bullets punching through with little effect, but it burns extremely readily.

ThingDef.label: ulgga
ThingDef.description: An extremely large, genetically engineered worm, armored and tusked but strangely peaceful for its size. Old records suggest it was once the worker caste of an artificial ecosystem, now running wild and self-sustaining out on the open sand.

ThingDef.label: vozzik
ThingDef.description: A massive slug, common on glitterworlds as a glorified mobile power plant. Off the grid it is deployed by research stations as a self-contained energy source; in the wild it simply grazes, slow and armored, across open ground.

ThingDef.label: zhakka
ThingDef.description: A large, genetically-engineered mite bred to synthesize volatile chemfuel in sacs beneath its shell. Once used to power industrial megaforges on distant worlds, wild zhakkas now scavenge the open desert, restless and short-lived but fast-breeding.

ThingDef.label: korrum
ThingDef.description: A massive genetically-engineered crab that carries a boulder for a shell. Korrums are placid to the point of indifference, ignoring nearly anything short of a direct attack, and their armor is thick enough that most predators leave them alone rather than bother. Old spacer stories tell of one grown so large it had a whole mountain for a home.
